attchmntText: SPML Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: SPML Infra Limited submitted a newspaper advertisement extract to the NSE and BSE regarding the publication of its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisement was published in Business Standard and Aarthik Lipi on 13th November 2026. Kesoram Textile Mills Limited reported a consolidated net loss of 336 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to a loss of 488 lakhs in the same period last year. The board approved these results on 12th November 2026. Naperol Investments Limited reported a consolidated net profit of 40.15 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The board approved these results on 11th November 2026. Naperol also announced a special window for transfer and dematerialization of physical shares from 5th February 2026 to 4th February 2027. Radheshyam Agarwalla Group reported a consolidated net profit of 4,875.74 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The board approved these results on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for utilization of proceeds for Quarter ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: SPML Infra Limited filed the First Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Brickwork Ratings India Private Limited. The report covers the utilization of funds raised through a preferential allotment aggregating to Rs. 183.18 Crore. As of September 30, 2026, the Company received Rs. 50.11 Crores, representing 27.3% of the total issue size. The balance 75% is receivable upon exercise of warrants within 18 months from the date of allotment. The monitoring agency confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. Funds utilized include Rs. 13.95 Crores for Capital Expenditure related to BESS Facility Enhancement and Container Manufacturing Unit, and Rs. 12.15 Crores for Working Capital Requirements. Unutilized proceeds of Rs. 23.00 Crores were invested in Fixed Deposits with Indian Overseas Bank. The report states that all government and statutory approvals have been obtained.

attchmntText: SPML Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "SPML Infra Strengthens Financial Performance in Q2 FY27".
voiceSummary: SPML Infra Limited filed a press release pursuant to Regulation 30 regarding results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue of 3524.4 crore, up 45% year on year, with profit after tax at 344.9 crore, up 64%. Q2 FY27 revenue was 3238.7 crore, up 20%, and profit after tax was 322.2 crore, up 46%. Operating cash flow for H1 FY27 showed an inflow of 82.4 crore, compared to an outflow of 344.1 crore in the previous period. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 3119.2 crore as of September 30, 2026. The company secured a 186.41 crore order from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited. Net worth increased to 1184.6 crore. The company maintains guidance for a minimum 25% growth for FY27.

attchmntText: SPML Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Mr. Manoj Kumar Digga as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. December 01, 2026.
voiceSummary: SPML Infra Limited approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter ended 30th September, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report. The Board also approved the cessation of Mr. Manoj Kumar Digga, DIN 01090626, as Chief Financial Officer, effective 1st December 2026. Mr. Digga will continue to serve as an Executive Director on the Board. Mr. Arun Kumar Agarwal was appointed as the new Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel, effective 1st December 2026. Mr. Agarwal has been authorized to determine the materiality of events and make requisite disclosures to the Stock Exchanges. The Board meeting was held on 12th November, 2026.

attchmntText: SPML Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mr. Arun Kumar Agarwal as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. December 01, 2026.
voiceSummary: SPML Infra Limited approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026. The Board accepted the resignation of Mr. Manoj Kumar Digga, DIN 01090626, as Chief Financial Officer, effective 1st December, 2026. Mr. Digga will continue as Executive Director. Mr. Arun Kumar Agarwal was appointed as the new Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel, effective 1st December, 2026. Mr. Agarwal is authorized to determine materiality of events and make disclosures. He is a qualified Cost and Management Accountant with over 29 years of experience. Previously, he served as Whole Time Director and CFO of VISA Industries Limited. The Board meeting concluded at 04:00 PM.

attchmntText: SPML Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on  Financial Result of Quarter 2 September 2026'.
voiceSummary: SPML Infra Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Mr. Manoj Kumar Digga ceased as Chief Financial Officer effective 1st December 2026, while continuing as Executive Director. Mr. Arun Kumar Agarwal was appointed as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel effective 1st December 2026. Mr. Agarwal is authorized to determine materiality of events and make requisite disclosures. The company reported a profit after tax of Rs. 2,215.49 lakhs for the three months ended 30th September 2026 and Rs. 4,465.20 lakhs for the six months ended same date. Earnings per share were Rs. 2.25 basic and Rs. 2.25 diluted for the quarter. The board meeting concluded at 4:00 PM on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: SPML Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: SPML Infra Limited has announced that its Q2 FY2026-2027 earnings call will be held on Monday, 16th November 2026 at 03:00 pm IST. The event will feature management representatives including Mr. Manoj Digga, Mr. Malay Kanti Chakraborty, Mr. Arun Agarwal, and Mr. Kapil Joshi. Participants can join via universal dial-in numbers or international toll-free lines. The information is also available on the company website at https://www.spml.co.in/.
